counties.notes: NH GRANIT publishes a statewide parcel mosaic with no login at nhgeodata.unh.edu/hosting/rest/services/Hosted/CAD_ParcelMosaic/FeatureServer/1: 617,124 parcels, CORS-enabled, 2,000 rows per page with pagination (checked 2026-10-17). It carries parcel ids, town, street address and land-use codes, but no owner field, so it cannot answer an owner lookup. An older GRANIT MapServer (nhgeodata.unh.edu/nhgeodata/rest/services/CAD/ParcelMosiac/MapServer) answered HTTP 499 without a token when this county was first researched. Owner records sit with each town's assessor: Hillsborough County municipalities (Manchester, Nashua and others) run their own parcel viewers through AxisGIS and Vision Government Solutions, which are property search pages, not queryable endpoints. Regrid covers NH commercially.

coverage.summary: New Hampshire's statewide parcel layer is public but carries no owner names; owner records are kept by each town's assessor. Search the town's assessor viewer, or request Hillsborough County and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: NH GRANIT's statewide parcel mosaic is public with no login at nhgeodata.unh.edu/hosting/rest/services/Hosted/CAD_ParcelMosaic/FeatureServer/1 (checked 2026-10-17), the same layer Hillsborough County's notes describe, but it has no owner field: parcel ids, town, street address and land-use codes only. An older GRANIT MapServer (nhgeodata.unh.edu/nhgeodata/rest/services/CAD/ParcelMosiac/MapServer) answered HTTP 499 without a token when this county was first researched. Rockingham County covers Portsmouth, Salem, Derry, Londonderry, and the southern tier of Manchester suburbs. Owner records sit with each town's assessor on separate vendor sites: Vision Government Solutions hosts assessor data for Salem, Derry, and several others, and AxisGIS serves Rye, Deerfield, and others; none expose a standard queryable ArcGIS FeatureServer. Regrid covers NH at commercial tier. The Rockingham County Registry of Deeds (ecourt.rockinghamregistry.com) is publicly searchable for recorded instruments but does not expose a REST parcel layer.
